name: forge-cycle
description: One rebuild cycle in the forge loop: plan, lanes, integrate, gate, promote. Promotion stays owner-gated.

steps.title: Cycle plan: {title}
steps.body: GLM-authored plan: scope, lane split, acceptance criteria, freeze list. Critic reviews plan before lanes open.

steps.title: Lane: {title} A
steps.body: Sandbox lane off the accepted head. Lanes never touch config/models.json or frozen tests.

steps.title: Integrate + board
steps.body: Merge lanes into integ branch, full board green, clean-clone verify.

steps.title: Clean-clone verify
steps.body: Fresh clone of the candidate: board must pass without the working tree.

steps.title: GLM gate review
steps.body: Reviewer != builder. Verdict-first, terse. PASS/NO-GO with reasons recorded as events.

steps.title: Promote to main (owner)
steps.body: The owner approves. Snapshot banked, changelog written, accepted head updated.
